Private Sub EncabezadoDelGrupo0_Format(Cancel As Integer, FormatCount As Integer)
If TotMesDeuda >= 6 Then
    Section(0).Visible = True
    Section(5).Visible = True
    Section(6).Visible = True
    Else
    Section(0).Visible = False
    Section(5).Visible = False
    Section(6).Visible = False
End If
End Sub
